Class Torus

java.lang.Object
com.cooke.shapes.Shape
com.cooke.shapes.ThreeDimensionalShape
com.cooke.shapes.Torus
public class Torus extends ThreeDimensionalShape
Torus Class Creates a Torus object with with a major radius and a minor radius; The Torus's volume is calculated when a new Torus is created and when the major radius or minor radius is adjusted. filename: Torus.java creation date: 20261027
Author:
Lawrence Cooke
